answer: Resist sybils with proof-of-replication: each identity seals a distinct multi-gigabyte replica whose bytes bind to its key through a slow trellis of sequential dependencies no clone can dedupe. The commitment is a ridge of hashes over those sealed bytes; random epoch challenges reopen it, so a farm running N fakes must keep N separate replicas frozen across its tundra of real disks, never one shared copy. The marginal fake costs continuous non-dedupable storage no coalition can pool, and settlement re-derives the ridge and burns the collateral behind any replica that misses a byte challenge.
